definitions.explanation: The social and economic class between the wealthy and the poor. In Japanese discourse, often refers to the broad middle segment of society that characterized postwar Japan.

examples.japanese: {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}が{減|へ}っている。
{中間層|ちゅうかんそう}の{所得|しょとく}が{伸|の}び{悩|なや}んでいる。
{新興国|しんこうこく}では{中間層|ちゅうかんそう}の{拡大|かくだい}が{経済成長|けいざいせいちょう}を{支|ささ}えている。
examples.english: In emerging countries, the expansion of the middle class is supporting economic growth.

notes:
Composed of {中間|ちゅうかん} (middle, intermediate) + {層|そう} (stratum, layer). In Japan, the concept of a broad middle class was central to postwar national identity — the phrase {一億総中流|いちおくそうちゅうりゅう} ("100 million all middle class") captured this self-image.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}の{拡大|かくだい} — expansion of the middle class
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}の{縮小|しゅくしょう} — shrinking of the middle class
- {中間層|ちゅうかんそう}{向|む}け — aimed at the middle class

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {中流|ちゅうりゅう} — middle class (less formal)
- {中産階級|ちゅうさんかいきゅう} — middle class (more formal/academic)
- {富裕層|ふゆうそう} — wealthy class
- {低所得層|ていしょとくそう} — low-income group
